free_tier.stated: No paid tier exists, so 1 TB is a ceiling and not a teaser

per_object_cap.stated: 100 MiB upload chunk per the login page's oc_appconfig; the per-object ceiling is the Nextcloud default and is not published

retention.stated: Until deleted. Public link expiry defaults to 7 days unless changed. No retention clock on stored files

egress.terms: No traffic allotment is published in the wiki or on the portal. The service is presented as free for personal use with a donation page and no metering is mentioned

tooling: rclone webdav, davfs2, curl -u, any Nextcloud client. The WebDAV endpoint is /remote.php/webdav/ for the legacy path and /remote.php/dav/ for the modern one, documented by the operator itself
chaining: A clean 1 TB WebDAV bucket with no payment and no phone, which drops straight into rclone mount or a Cloudflare-fronted origin. Each account is an independent island and the signup form has a phone field, so farming is not free

limits.value: 100 MiB upload chunk; the per-object ceiling is unpublished
signup needs a name, date of birth, sex, an international phone number, a postcode and the reCAPTCHA v3 human-verification widget token

identity_cost.detail: the signup form requires prenom, nom, date of birth, sexe, an international phone number and a postcode, plus the reCAPTCHA v3 human-verification widget. The JavaScript has no SMS or code path, so the only gate actually exercised is an email activation link

reliability_note: A single-sponsor instance operated by PSIADE in Toulouse. A 2024 help.nextcloud.com thread predicted imminent shutdown and reported stale certificates; the instance now answers status.php as Nextcloud 31.0.6.2 with valid TLS, so that post is stale, but one funding decision still ends it. The .jp mirror is dead

evidence.proved: HTTP 200, {"installed":true,"version":"31.0.6.2","productname":"Nextcloud"}, so a live current server
HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="Ploud Storage", so the DAV read path exists and is auth-gated
HTTP 401, 584 bytes, real SabreDAV XML with Sabre\DAV\Exception\NotAuthenticated and X-Powered-By: PHP/8.3.8
'Vous disposez d'un espace de 500 Go ou 1 To' plus the explicit WebDAV URL https://storage.ploud.fr/remote.php/webdav/
'Ploud Storage: 1 espace de stockage securise et crypte de 1 To'
operated by PSIADE SAS, servers in France near Paris, no ad model, donation page
signup posts to php/create_userv2.php with name, date of birth, sex, phone, postcode and email plus a grecaptcha token, with no SMS code anywhere in the bundle

binding_note: 1 TB free with a working WebDAV endpoint clears the capacity and protocol filters. What binds is the signup: a phone number and an address are collected, and the form is a single-sponsor instance's only gate, so an account that survives is a favour rather than a contract.
notes: The best free Nextcloud in Europe by volume and the least durable: one sponsor, one data centre, and a 2024 forum thread that has already predicted its closure once. A reader should use it with a second copy and not as the second copy.
